title: Thank You Pack:
title_short: Vishal · Thank You Pack: Top Lender
headline: Kiva's CEO personally thanks this year's top lenders: first year or many years, your money is helping people build better lives.
story: One of Vishal's thank-you videos for Kiva's lenders, from Kiva's own prompt: “Share a thank you for being one of our top lenders so far this year.” He uses the third take, which says it works for a first-year top lender and for a long-time one.
Simple and warm: who he is, the thank you, what their money does, and a last thank you. It matches the other two Thank You Pack cuts (first loan, first donation): same super, captions and end card.
do: Use the third top-lender take only (B cam 08:03 to 08:39).
Open on frame 1 on Vishal saying “Hi”, hook text on screen. Period after his name in the caption.
Cut the stutter so the caption reads “lending for a long time,”.
Hide each cut on the close B cam angle.
Match the first-loan and first-donation cuts.
dont: Never use the crew's suggested line (“Whether you've been giving…”).
Never “investment” on screen. No money graphic.
No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
No crowded captions and no lime.

checklist: His name is Vishal Ghotge (G-H-O-T-G-E) everywhere. Never the transcript's “Kodke”.

The word “investment” is nowhere on screen. “U.S.”, never “United States”.
Captions match his words exactly, in Kiva green #2AA967, smaller, low, with clear space between letters and words.
Frame 1 is picture with the hook text. No black, no logo, no fade at 0:00.
The green K logo sits in a top corner from 0:03 and its letters are Kiva green.
End card reads exactly “Give a little. Change a lot.” and kiva.org.
First caption reads “Hi, I'm Vishal Ghotge.” with a period, then “I'm the CEO of Kiva.”
The stutter is cut: the caption reads “lending for a long time,” with no “or” or “you've”.
Every line is from the third top-lender take.
Same super, captions and end card as the first-loan and first-donation cuts.

decisions.b: No written brief on this item. Kiva's standing rule is 16:9 and a vertical for every video, so this plan delivers both. Nick: say if the Thank You Pack is vertical only.
Production Planning has no reference for the Seattle shoot. Nick picks one.

client_note: Why this matters: Kiva will send this to its most loyal lenders. It must feel personal, and every caption must be exactly right.
